about.title: Hi, I’m Tuấn. Nice to meet you.
about.bio: Since beginning my journey as a full-stack developer, I've built end-to-end web products, architected robust backend APIs, and engineered smooth user interfaces. I'm quietly confident, naturally curious, and constantly working on improving my craft.
paragraphs: I'm a full-stack developer with 2+ years of experience building web products end to end. I work comfortably across PHP/Laravel, Next.js, NestJS and Ruby.
I care about readable architecture, reusable components and interfaces that feel fast, so a feature is easy to ship today and easy to change tomorrow.
